snippet.title: Becastled: Traits and Some Magic | Free DLC Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready for more magic in Becastled! 

Traits and Some Magic is a free DLC coming on October 22, bringing new ways to build your strategy and defend the Sun Kingdom against the Moon Beasts. 

What's new: 
• Over 40 new traits with bonuses, debuffs, and restrictions 
• Two new units: Mages and Clerics 
• A new Mage School 
• Three new achievements 

Choose new traits throughout your run, experiment with different combinations, and discover new ways to defend your castle. 

Becastled is developed by Mana Potion Studio and published by Pingle Studio. 

Play Becastled: 
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/EP8247-PPSA30930_00-0078184614991480
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/EP8247-CUSA55182_00-0492294933478026

Website: https://pinglestudio.com/
